title: Pure Ninja
summary: Pure Ninja and Ninjitsu Art control build with generic staples. The deck flips monsters on both fields face-down and face-up, Contact Fusions into Meizen the Battle Ninja and Yaguramaru the Armor Ninja, and uses Ninjitsu Art Continuous Traps to tribute face-down monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ninja Grandmaster Hanzo searches a Ninjitsu Art card from the Deck when Normal Summoned, and searches any Ninja monster besides itself when Flip or Special Summoned.
Ninjitsu Art Notebook of Mystery Sets 1 Ninja monster and 1 Ninjitsu Art Spell/Trap from your Deck and/or GY (one from each if possible) while the opponent controls a card.

Tobari the Sky Ninja sends itself from the hand to the GY to Special Summon a Ninja from your hand in face-up or face-down Defense Position, and Fusion Summons a Ninja Fusion Monster as a Quick Effect during the opponent's Main or Battle Phase.

summary.title: Opening: Ninja Grandmaster Hanzo
steps: Normal Summon Ninja Grandmaster Hanzo and search Ninjitsu Art of Dancing Leaves (or Ninjitsu Art Notebook of Mystery).

If you also have Mitsu the Insect Ninja, Baku the Beast Ninja, or Bat, the Forest Ninja (with Hidden Village of Ninjitsu Arts), Special Summon it and Contact Fusion Hanzo + the second Ninja into Meizen the Battle Ninja (or Link Summon Ninja Grandmaster Saizo to Set a Ninjitsu Art straight from the Deck).

On the opponent's turn, when they activate a card or effect, trigger Meizen the Battle Ninja to summon Jioh the Gravity Ninja from the Deck face-up or face-down, flipping 2 monsters on the field permanently face-down.

summary.title: Flip Control & Contact Fusions
summary.text: Both Meizen the Battle Ninja (2 Ninjas with different Types) and Yaguramaru the Armor Ninja (2 Ninjas with different Types) can either be Fusion Summoned with Tobari or Special Summoned from the Extra Deck by tributing their materials on the field. Jioh the Gravity Ninja flips up to 2 monsters on the field permanently face-down when Normal, Special, or Flip Summoned, and destroys a card on the field whenever any monster on the field is flipped face-up. Mitsu the Insect Ninja flips a face-down Ninja you control face-up (triggering Hanzo or Jioh) and flips itself face-down to negate an opponent's monster effect.

summary.title: Extra Deck & Payoff
points: Meizen the Battle Ninja Special Summons a Ninja from the Deck in face-up or face-down Defense Position whenever the opponent activates a card or effect, and lets all your Ninja monsters attack directly while you control a face-down Defense Position monster.
Yaguramaru the Armor Ninja banishes a Ninja or Ninjitsu Art card from your hand, GY, or face-up field to banish any card on the field when Special Summoned or Flipped face-up.

Ninja Grandmaster Saizo Sets a Ninjitsu Art Spell/Trap directly from the Deck during your Main Phase, and Number 2: Ninja Shadow Mosquito (Rank 2 from Mitsu and Green Ninja) negates opposing monsters with Hallucination Counters and reflects battle damage.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Left out
points: Ninjitsu Art of Dancing Leaves tributes any Ninja or any face-down Defense Position monster on either field (including an opponent's monster Jioh flipped face-down) to Special Summon a Ninja from the Deck.

Hidden Village of Ninjitsu Arts recovers a Ninja or Ninjitsu Art from your GY when a Ninja is summoned and banishes a GY Ninja to prevent destruction; Ninjitsu Art Tool - Iron Digger treats the equipped monster as a Ninja and banishes a GY Ninja to destroy a card.
Left out: the page's Branded and Horus engines, Karakuri Ninjas, and Penguin Ninja, plus Fairy Tale Prologue: Journey's Dawn for Bat, the Forest Ninja's search.
